eyebrow.zh: 一条命令 · 自动找上一次跑通 · 本地不上传
eyebrow.en: One command · Finds the last run that worked · Local, no upload

headline.zh:
只丢一份失败记录
它自动找回上次跑通的那次
headline.en:
Hand it the failed run
it finds the last one that worked

sub.zh: 从你的 Claude Code 会话历史里，自动挑出同一任务最近一次干净跑完的运行，把两次运行逐步对齐，精准定位两者分道扬镳的那一步——指向的不是会话文件时，也会明说，而不是假装没有分歧。
sub.en: It scans your Claude Code session history for the most recent clean run of the same task, lines the two runs up step by step, and pinpoints the exact step where they parted ways — and if you hand it something that isn't a session, it says so instead of a false "no divergence".

title.zh: 不用再翻出上次跑通的那次
title.en: No more digging up the run that worked

body.zh: 省掉手动满世界找那份对照运行：按你的任务——工作目录、分支、原始请求——从 Claude Code 会话历史里自动挑出最近一次干净跑完的运行，缓存好，下次同一任务直接复用。只丢一份失败记录就能开跑；会话目录里有个坏文件或读不动的那条，也不影响自动找回——跳过它继续扫。
body.en: Skip the manual hunt for the run to compare against: it auto-picks the most recent clean run of your task — by working directory, branch and original request — from your Claude Code session history, caches it, and reuses it next time the same task comes up. Hand it just the failed run and go; a broken or unreadable file sitting in the history won't abort the auto-resolve either — it's skipped, not fatal.

chips: › 缓存复用 · 同任务零成本
› 坏文件不中断自动找回

title.en: The one step that broke it

body.zh: 别再肉眼比对几百个步骤。成功运行与失败运行首次分叉的那一步，几乎总是最该深究的——几秒内呈现在你面前。指向的不是会话文件时，它会明确告诉你，而不是甩给你一句假装没有分歧的空结果。
body.en: Stop scanning two hundred steps by eye. The first step where a passing run and a failing run parted ways is almost always the one worth staring at — and it's handed to you in seconds. Point it at a file that isn't a session and it tells you so, instead of handing back a silent empty "no divergence" result.

chips: › 首次分叉 · 不是整段 diff
› 指错文件会明说，不假装没分歧

title.zh: 绝不把两个不同任务拿来比对

body.zh: 在对齐之前，先比对两次运行的工作目录、分支与原始请求——一旦指向不同任务的运行，立刻提醒你。
body.en: Before any alignment, the working directory, branch, and original request of both runs are compared — so you're warned the instant you point it at runs that aren't the same task.

title.zh: 一眼看到分叉，全程本地

body.zh: 两次运行并排渲染，分叉处高亮——一眼看清分叉，无需在两份日志间来回对照。本地页面打开，不上云、不传你的会话记录；端口被占也能干净退出，不甩你一脸原始报错。
body.en: Both runs render next to each other, the divergence lit up — so a human sees the fork in one glance instead of cross-referencing two logs. It opens a local page: no cloud, no upload of your transcripts; and a busy port exits cleanly instead of dumping a raw stack trace.

headline.zh: 从「Agent 退化了」到「Agent 在这一步退化」
headline.en: From 'the agent regressed' to 'the agent regressed at this step'

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。本地比对这一核心动作，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. The core act of comparing runs locally is never gated.

tag.zh: 面向编码智能体的 git-bisect · 找出走偏的那一步
tag.en: git-bisect for coding agents · find the step where it went wrong
